mods.abstract: Atlanta Fed president and CEO Raphael Bostic speaks to the National Council for Economic Education about the economic outlook, how he gathers economic information, and the key role educators play in helping students develop an interest in economics.

titleInfo.title: The Importance of Early Economic Education
titleInfo.subTitle: [Speech at] 57th Annual Financial Literacy and Economic Education Conference, National Conference for Economic Education, Atlanta, Georgia
